description: Talk to Wizzo, WizTrip's travel agent from wiz-trip.com/arma-tu-viaje, to build a trip: destinations, dates, travellers, flights and hotels, single or multi-city. Pass the traveller's request as `message` (in Spanish if they speak Spanish; Wizzo answers in Spanish). The first call starts a trip and returns its `trip_id`: pass it on every following call. Wizzo searches real flights and hotels and may show options to choose (use trip_choose). Relay what Wizzo says faithfully; prices are WizTrip selling prices in USD. When the trip is ready the card shows «Reservar ahora», which opens the wiz-trip.com checkout where the person pays. The card shows Wizzo's words, the options and the booking buttons. Today is 2026-11-25. Each call returns within seconds; while Wizzo is still working the answer gives a `turn_id`: call trip_chat again right away with the same trip_id and that turn_id, without `message`, until Wizzo answers. Never send the same message twice.

trip_id.description: The trip id returned by a previous trip_chat call. Omit it to start a new trip.

turn_id.description: Only to keep waiting on a turn that was still running: the turn_id it returned.

name: trip_chat
title: Armá tu viaje con Wizzo
